questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Shopping online late at night and the problems it causes
How shopping malls are closing in towns across Britain
Why vampires and night creatures are popular in films
How to get a refund from a shop when something breaks
questions.why: They discuss 'vampire shopping', which means shopping late at night.

questions.q: How does Rob feel about shopping?
options: He loves spending weekends in big shopping malls
He hates going round shops but finds online easier
He never buys anything unless it is on sale
He only shops at night when the shops are quiet
questions.why: He calls malls 'my idea of hell' but says browsing online is much easier.

questions.q: Which group is NOT mentioned as likely to be awake late at night?
options: Shift workers
Gamers
Students
Parents who lack sleep
questions.why: Rob mentions sleep-deprived parents, shift-workers and gamers.

questions.q: According to Helen Undy, what happens to us when we're sleep deprived?
options: We buy cheaper things that we don't really need
We stop paying attention to online advertising
We make better and faster decisions about money
We find it harder to control the urge to spend
questions.why: She says our ability to control our impulse to spend is reduced.

questions.q: Why is late-night shopping a bigger problem for people with mental health issues?
options: Their problems make it harder to resist and disturb sleep
They have more money to spend because they stay at home
They are more interested in technology and new gadgets
They don't know how to return things they don't want
questions.why: She says mental health problems make it harder to resist and also cause sleep deprivation.

questions.q: What has Rob bought that he regretted?
options: Clothes online that didn't fit him
A new car he couldn't really afford
Tech and cheap flights he didn't want
Expensive food from a delivery app
questions.why: He mentions bits of tech and flight tickets to somewhere he didn't want to go.

questions.q: What did Helen Undy's research find about returning regretted purchases?
options: Most people returned them within a week
Three-quarters didn't return the last thing they regretted
Only people with mental health problems kept them
Shops usually refused to give people their money back
questions.why: She says 75% of people didn't send back the last thing they regretted.

questions.q: Why did 4 in 10 people with mental health problems not return items?
options: Sending it back by post was too expensive
They forgot about it until it was too late
The shops were closed or wouldn't answer
They were ashamed and wanted to forget it
questions.why: They were so ashamed they just wanted to pretend it never happened.
